message:
I have a friend who seems to think every storm is the end of the world. Last winter, when the forecast called for a mere dusting of snow, she texted me ten times about the impending doom. I finally invited her over for a cup of hot cocoa and a game of cards. 

We ended up laughing more than worrying, and I realized that sometimes, a calm chat can feel more comforting than all the supplies in the world. 

So, when the weather gets a little dicey, I find it helps to keep it light and remind myself to breathe. 

What’s your go-to trick for staying calm when storms roll in? ☕️
